verdict.rationale: The docs confirm that ElevenLabs Agents store conversation transcripts and audio recordings, with configurable retention defaulting to 2 years, and that conversation history can be searched. The API is documented for managing agents, but no evidence shows an API endpoint for fetching recordings or transcripts. Missing for 10: documented API/SDK endpoints for downloading audio recordings and full transcripts, webhook or bulk-export delivery for every call, coverage of telephony/SIP calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
